name: cinetrekker
description: A modern, cinematic movie and TV tracking web application designed for exploration, personal library management, and episode tracking.
author: Mohamed Jebahi <mohamed.jebahi21@gmail.com>

scripts.i18n:verify: npm run i18n:audit:strict && npm run i18n:fill:check
scripts.test: npm run test:ci && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test:security && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:professionalization && npm run i18n:verify

scripts.test:smoke: playwright test tests/smoke.spec.ts tests/header-quick-controls.spec.ts tests/locale-switching.spec.ts tests/rtl-overlay-stability.spec.ts tests/public-trust-routes.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.audit:desktop:full: npm run build && npm run audit:desktop
scripts.test:e2e:desktop: playwright test --grep-invert 'CineTrekker visual regression' --project=chromium --workers=2 && playwright test --grep-invert 'CineTrekker visual regression' --project=firefox --workers=1 && playwright test --grep-invert 'CineTrekker visual regression' --project=webkit --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:mobile:search-regressions: playwright test tests/mobile-features.spec.ts --project=mobile-safari --grep "slash shortcuts do not open a second search dialog"
